inventory.description: SHA-256 over UTF-8 lines relative/path|byteLength|lowercaseFileSha256, ordinal-ignore-case sorted, with a final LF. Inputs are magick.exe, root DLL/XML files, License.txt, NOTICE.txt, and every file below modules.

provenance.note: SAME upstream release as the ARM64 pin (7.1.2-31). Bumped from 7.1.2-29 for the security advisories published since (among them heap over-writes in GetVirtualPixels and the distributed pixel cache, MVG and XMP-profile denial of service, a use-after-free in the cairo-less RSVG decoder, and policy bypasses in the MAT/CUT/PCD/CUBE/HALD coders). Downloaded from the GitHub release (SHA-256 matches the release's published digest, Authenticode-signed by ImageMagick Studio LLC) and installed over the previous copy in %ProgramFiles%\ImageMagick-7.1.2-Q16-HDRI with the same DLL build and task; the installed inventory equals a fresh innoextract of the same installer (198 files, three more than -29).
